connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Connect to a commissioned Futura L/M/S. L+ is unsupported. The probe only reads; no values are written.

device_info.title: Verified unit

zones.title: Zones · 8 supply + 8 exhaust
zones.description:
Select a zone to edit its name and area. Physical damper/ALFA bindings are preserved. Zones organize the UI; slot numbers determine the meaning in Futura.

{zones}

zone_disabled.title: Associated slots
zone_disabled.description: This zone has associated slots. Keep them without a zone or disable them while retaining their sources.

preview.title: Measurement preview

sensor_slots.title: Sensors · 8 independent slots
sensor_slots.description:
Choose a slot to edit. None does not read or write. Read observes Futura. HA Write-back sends selected Home Assistant values and reads them back. You can continue without configuring any slot.

{slots}

sensor_detail.title: Sensor · slot {slot}
sensor_detail.description: Zone binding is optional and only organizes the UI. It does not change the register address or physical zone. Disabled/None preserves saved sources.

sensor_sources.title: HA sources · slot {slot}
sensor_sources.description: Select at least one source. All four metrics use the same unit validation, including floor temperature. Confirm a target unit only for a source without units. Another writer may overwrite these values; do not run another writing client concurrently. IN1/IN2 and unit regulation may override the effect.

data.temperature_unitless: For a unitless temperature source, assume °C
data.humidity_unitless: For a unitless relative humidity source, assume %
data.co2_unitless: For a unitless co₂ source, assume ppm
data.floor_temperature_unitless: For a unitless floor temperature source, assume °C

sensor_readback.title: Sensor readback · slot {slot}
sensor_readback.description:
{readings}

Values read from Futura holding registers. An absent or invalid metric is unavailable, not zero. Continue keeps this draft without writing.

button_slots.title: Buttons · 8 independent slots
button_slots.description:
None does not read or write. Futura reads a button controlled elsewhere. HA Control creates a button and service, even without a physical button.

{slots}

button_detail.title: Button · slot {slot}
button_detail.description: The optional zone binding is organizational only. Choosing HA Control explicitly selects Home Assistant control. Do not use a second writer for the same slot.

button_action.title: Action · slot {slot}
button_action.description: Choose the action. Switching action proposes Boost 180 s or Digestor 300 s; adjust the timer in the next step.

button_timer.title: Timer · slot {slot}
button_timer.description: Default duration must not exceed the configured maximum (1–10800 s). A command is not replayed after an outage. Acknowledged transfer does not prove ventilation started. Recovery is only for a previously failed deactivation: after saving, attempt one cleanup before enabling another press.

button_readback.title: Button readback · slot {slot}
button_readback.description:
{readings}

Futura mode is read-only. The timer is an observed value, not a control.

runtime.title: Intervals and bridge
runtime.description: Bridge enables sensor writes only; buttons are independent. Readback and standard polling have separate intervals. Watchdog must be at least the write interval rounded up to seconds. Maximum age of the last source report is entered in seconds; the default for a new or missing setting is 60 minutes = 3600 s. Saved values are preserved: to change, for example, 120 s to 60 minutes, save 3600. This limit does not change the write interval; unknown/unavailable and invalid values are invalidated on evaluation.
